name: Point Of Interaction Capabilities 11
definition: Capabilities of the POI (Point Of Interaction) performing the transaction.

CardReadingCapabilities.name: Card Reading Capabilities
CardReadingCapabilities.definition: Card reading capabilities of the POI (Point Of Interaction) performing the transaction.

CardholderVerificationCapabilities.name: Cardholder Verification Capabilities
CardholderVerificationCapabilities.definition: Cardholder verification capabilities of the POI (Point Of Interaction) performing the transaction.

PINLengthCapabilities.name: PIN Length Capabilities
PINLengthCapabilities.definition: Maximum number of digits the POI is able to accept when the cardholder enters its PIN.

ApprovalCodeLength.name: Approval Code Length
ApprovalCodeLength.definition: Maximum number of characters of the approval code the POI is able to manage.

MaxScriptLength.name: Max Script Length
MaxScriptLength.definition: Maximum data length in bytes that a card issuer can return to the ICC at the terminal.

CardCaptureCapable.name: Card Capture Capable
CardCaptureCapable.definition: True if the POI is able to capture card.

OnLineCapabilities.name: On Line Capabilities
OnLineCapabilities.definition: On-line and off-line capabilities of the POI (Point Of Interaction).

MessageCapabilities.name: Message Capabilities
MessageCapabilities.definition: Capabilities of the terminal to display or print message to the cardholder and the merchant.
